elements.label: About
elements.value: Raycast-based collision that pushes the camera toward the player when geometry is in the way.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/collision_avoidance.schema.json, set ca_c_enabled to {{ca_c_enabled}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.enableCollision to {{ca_c_enabled}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/collision_avoidance.schema.json, set ca_t_radius to {{ca_t_radius}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.collisionRadius to {{ca_t_radius}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/collision_avoidance.schema.json, set ca_t_raycasts to {{ca_t_raycasts}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.numRaycastAttempts to {{ca_t_raycasts}}. Higher = more accurate collision at more CPU cost.
